Obligation discharged.

```
$ python -m pytest tests -q
1342 passed, 4 skipped, 1 xfailed in 11.97s
```

**What was wrong:** the `.venv` had nothing installed but `pip`, so `import attr` fell through to a globally-installed `attrs 26.1.0` in `%APPDATA%\Roaming\Python\Python313\site-packages`. The suite was testing that unrelated release instead of this checkout — hence the 12 failures.

**Fix:** pointed the venv at the checkout. A proper `pip install -e .` wasn't possible here (no network; the local wheelhouse has hatchling/hatch-vcs/hatch-fancy-pypi-readme but not `editables`, which the hatchling editable hook requires), so I installed the build backend from the wheelhouse and then wrote the path file an editable install would have produced:

```
.venv/Lib/site-packages/attrs-src.pth  ->  <repo>/src
```

`.venv\Lib\site-packages` precedes the user site directory on `sys.path`, so `attr` now resolves to `src/attr/__init__.py`. This is environment setup only — `git status` still shows exactly the three files of the commit, nothing added or ignored.

**Final state:**
- `python -m pytest tests -q` — 1342 passed, 4 skipped, 1 xfailed
- `ruff check .` — All checks passed
- `ruff format --check` on tracked Python/pyi files — 62 files already formatted
- Diff: `.pre-commit-config.yaml` (rev `v0.11.12` → `v0.16.3`), `pyproject.toml` (new ignores + the pattern-matching exclusion), `src/attr/_make.py` (the `FURB171` fix)
